name: cal-01-month-drum
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — month drum + white letter inlay, FULL SIZE. REVIVED as the retry after cal-03 failed: this was originally a measurement-only plate, then superseded by the paired cal-03, which let go of the plate at layer 4 and was dragged into a spaghetti mess that popped the print cover off. Two changes from cal-03, and only two. (1) BRIM, SET EXPLICITLY. cal-03 ran brim_type auto_brim / brim_width 0 — the slicer's auto-brim reads footprint AREA and decided no brim was needed. That is a blind spot for a tall thin-walled ring: month.stl has 3147mm2 of bed contact standing 40mm tall, versus date10.stl which printed clean on cal-02 with effectively identical contact (3146mm2) standing only 11mm. Contact-per-height 79 vs 286, same config, one held and one did not. Do not put this back to auto. (2) UN-PAIRED from the day drum. Pairing shared one flush band and saved ~60g of purge, but it also put both 40mm drums in a single 7h46m run — which is exactly what was lost. Prove the brim on one drum first; cal-08 carries day. Bed temp deliberately NOT raised: 55 already trips a bed_temperature_too_high_than_filament warning, so raising it trades one problem for another. One variable at a time. REGISTRATION unchanged and still unproven on plastic: letter bbox-centre delta [0.000, +0.109], z_offset 2.672 (base min-z 17.00 vs letter 19.67). Expect the two-colour band near layer 13; a band starting at layer 0 means the offset was dropped. FILAMENT: slot 1 black PLA MATTE, slot 2 white PLA BASIC, ams_mapping 2,0 — only the FIRST filament is AMS-checked, read the mapping by eye.
